title: 第9章 第一个技能第10章 你已经10级了
slug: 我妈等着治病你召唤我当勇者
content_zh:
林默眼中寒光一闪，脚下发力。
整个人如同离弦之箭，不退反进。
迎着那气势汹汹的青色巨狼对冲而去！
他打算速战速决。
然而，就在双方距离急速拉近。
眼看就要碰撞的瞬间，异变突生！
那携着万钧之势扑来的风狼王。
庞大的身躯在空中猛地一阵扭曲、晃动。
变得虚幻而不真实。
紧接着，在林默略显惊愕的目光下，它竟然一分为二。
凭空分裂出了另一头体型、样貌，甚至气势都一模一样的巨狼！
这是技能？
林默心中骤然一紧。
他完全没料到。
这看似只靠肉体力量的魔物，竟然还掌握着如此诡异的能力！
不过，这突如其来的变化并未让他慌乱。
冲刺的势头丝毫不减。
他紧握黑剑，手腕一抖。
剑锋划出一道凌厉的弧线。
精准地斩向离自己最近的那头风狼王。

预想中利刃切入血肉的阻滞感并未传来。
黑剑如同砍过一片虚无的空气。
被击中的风狼王发出一声轻微的噗声。
瞬间溃散，化作一团紊乱的气流消失不见。
是分身！
假的！
几乎在识破第一个分身的同一时刻。
另一头风狼王已经凭借惊人的爆发力，趁着林默出剑的间隙，突进到了他的身体左侧。
那只堪比磨盘大小的巨爪，带着撕裂空气的尖啸，猛地向他腰间横扫而来！
爪尖闪烁着幽冷的寒光。
这若是抓实了，足以将普通人拦腰截断！
林默反应极快。
腰腹核心瞬间发力，身体以一个诡异的角度强行扭转。
险之又险地避开了这致命的一爪。
凌厉的爪风刮得他腰侧的麻布衣服嗤啦作响。
在闪避的同时。
content_en:
Lin Mo's eyes flashed coldly, and he exerted force on his feet.
The whole person is like an arrow leaving the string, not retreating but advancing.
He charged towards the menacing giant cyan wolf!
He intended to make a quick decision.
However, the distance between the two sides quickly narrowed.
At the moment when they were about to collide, a sudden change occurred!
The Wind Wolf King rushed towards him with great force.
The huge body suddenly twisted and shook in the air.
Becoming unreal and unreal.
Then, under Lin Mo's slightly shocked gaze, it split into two.
Another giant wolf split out of thin air with exactly the same size, appearance, and even momentum!
Is this a skill?
Lin Mo's heart suddenly tightened.
He didn't expect it at all.
This monster, which seems to rely solely on physical strength, actually possesses such strange abilities!
However, this sudden change did not panic him.
The momentum of the sprint continues unabated.
He gripped the black sword tightly and flicked his wrist.
The sword edge drew a sharp arc.
He accurately slashed at the Wind Wolf King closest to him.
The expected feeling of blockage from the sharp blade cutting into the flesh was not felt.
The black sword seemed to cut through a void of air.
The Wind Wolf King who was hit made a slight popping sound.
It collapsed instantly and disappeared into a chaotic airflow.
It's a clone!
Fake!
Almost at the same moment when the first clone was discovered.
The other wind wolf king had already used his amazing explosive power to rush to the left side of Lin Mo's body while he was using his sword.
That giant claw, which was as big as a millstone, swept towards his waist with a scream that ripped through the air!
The tips of the claws shone with a cold light.
If this is true, it will be enough to cut off ordinary people!
Lin Mo reacted very quickly.
The core of the waist and abdomen exerted force instantly, and the body was forcibly twisted at a strange angle.
He narrowly avoided this fatal claw.
The sharp claw wind made the linen clothes at his waist rustle.
While dodging.
